intro:

faqs.q: What does targeted SEO mean exactly?
faqs.a: It means every SEO action is chosen for its likely revenue impact on YOUR business — not a generic checklist. We target the keywords, pages, and audiences most likely to become your customers in Liverpool and beyond.

faqs.a: Standard packages do the same tasks for every client. Targeted SEO starts with your market, competitors, and margins, then builds marketing strategies around what will actually move your needle. Less waste, faster results.
